{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|gunner}}
[[File:RogueGunner-TPoV.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] gunner]]
{{Quote|Wedge, I've lost my gunner. You'll have to make this shot. I'll cover for you. Set your harpoon. Follow me on the next pass.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], to [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
The term '''gunner''' described a person who operated weapon systems onboard armed vehicles or [[Starship/Legends|starships]].

==Description==
Typically stationed in a vehicle operated by multiple crewmembers, gunners controlled weapons that usually operated independently of the vehicle's [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] or, in the case of larger starships, the rest of the crew.
[[File:Rodian-gunner.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] gunner]]
A gunner would either be in charge of all of a vehicle's weapons (like in the [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]]), in split control of a vehicle's weapons with the vehicle's pilot (like in the [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 airspeeder]], [[Aleph-class starfighter|''Aleph''-class starfighter]], or [[Scimitar assault bomber]]), or in co-control of the vehicle's weapons along with one or more other crewmembers (like in a [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat|Skipray Blastboat]] or an [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]]). The kinds of weapons that required independent gunners included rear-firing [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] or [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], [[Quad laser cannon/Legends|quad lasers]] and [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launchers]]. Gunners in capital-ship grade weapons emplacements such as [[Turbolaser/Legends|heavy turbolaser batteries]] and [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] almost always operated as part of a larger weapons crew under the [[weapons-control officer]].

Gunners served on many types of vehicles including [[Walker/Legends|walkers]], military [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]] and [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]], [[Starship/Legends|starships]] of all sizes, and ground-based turrets of all types, including anti-vehicle and anti-personnel emplacements. Those serving as gunners, both in a civilian and military capacities, often went through special simulator and live-fire training in order to become certified in the operation of their weapon of choice and to improve their skills.

Those notable for their skill as gunners included [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]], along with many [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] such as [[Saba Sebatyne]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and many others. It was through their use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], which allowed them to sense the intentions of the enemy, that gave them a distinct edge over their opponents, particularly when dealing with enemy [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] while manning small-scale anti-ship weapons.

Among the ranks of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], the rank of [[True Gunner]] was the highest order of gunnery awarded to those who displayed superior abilities. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] Janson earned his True Gunner's insignia during his early days of service to the Rebellion.

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] served as tailgunner for [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] during the hunt for the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], a massive [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] battleship. From this vantage point, Tano observed a flaw in Anakin's all-out assault strategy in his attack of the ''Malevolence's'' [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]]. At her urging, Anakin changed strategy and had his [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] target the ''Malevolence's'' [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] instead.<ref name="SWE Y-wing fighter">{{SWE|technology|ywing|Y-wing starfighter}}</ref>
